cards.soWhat: Apple Search Ads is the stronger paid acquisition channel: $15.03 per user and 32.1% pay versus TikTok’s $5.09 and 12.2%. Shift budget from TikTok to Apple Search Ads until TikTok can improve payer rate and reduce its 15.5% refund rate.

Day-one AI edit depth is a clear revenue signal: users with 5+ edits bring $15.21 per user and pay at 32.4%, while 0-edit users pay at only 9.6%. Optimize onboarding and campaigns to push new users to complete 5+ AI edits on day one.

NL, US, DE, SE, and GB are the best markets for paid acquisition, with $12–15 per user versus IN at $1.39, TR at $1.87, and MX at $3.35. Concentrate spend in the top markets and limit budget in the weakest ones.

Product photos users from Apple Search Ads are the highest-value segment shown, with $19.61 per user and 39.5% pay. Build dedicated Apple Search Ads campaigns around product photos before scaling family or travel.
